quarterly_data.quarter: Trumpf press release: TRUMPF reports increase in profit and order intake / Global (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (CEO Nicola Leibinger-Kammueller): TRUMPF expects further growth in the current fiscal year 2026/27 and remains 'cautiously optimistic' about an economic upturn despite geopolitical tensions and trade restrictions; the positive trend was 'clearly confirmed' in the first quarter of fiscal 2026/27. The company sees significant opportunities in electromobility, semiconductors and power electronics and, in machine tools, manufacturing technologies for equipping data centers, smart factory solutions and services, plus humanoid robotics.
